title: "Print School Reports"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(here)

schools  <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "schools.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
visits   <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "visits.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Read full update data
raw_full <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "full_update.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
clean_full <- raw_full |>
  slice(-1) |>
  rename(school_name = Q2) |>
  mutate(school_name = str_trim(school_name))

# Date range defaults
visit_dates <- visits$visit_date[!is.na(visits$visit_date)]
date_min <- as.character(min(visit_dates))
date_max <- as.character(max(visit_dates))

# Build the full data object for all schools
all_school_data <- list()
for (name in sort(schools$school_name)) {
  slug <- name |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |>
    str_remove("-$")

  school_visits <- visits |> filter(school_name == name) |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character))

  all_school_data[[slug]] <- list(
    info        = schools |> filter(school_name == name) |> as.list(),
    visits      = school_visits,
    full_update = clean_full |> filter(school_name == name) |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  )
}

data_json <- toJSON(all_school_data, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

htmltools::HTML(paste0('
<style>
  @media print {
    /* Hide everything except the reports */
    .navbar, .quarto-title, #controls-bar, .nav-footer, header, nav,
    #quarto-header, #quarto-sidebar, .quarto-title-block { display: none !important; }

    #print-area { display: block !important; }

    .school-report {
      page-break-after: always;
      padding: 0.5in 0;
      font-size: 11pt;
    }
    .school-report:last-child { page-break-after: avoid; }

    .school-report h2 {
      color: #1C2B4A !important;
      font-size: 16pt;
      margin-bottom: 4pt;
      border-bottom: 2pt solid #F5B800;
      padding-bottom: 4pt;
    }
    .school-report .meta { color: #555; font-size: 9pt; margin-bottom: 10pt; }
    .school-report .programs-list { margin-bottom: 10pt; }
    .school-report .badge-print {
      display: inline-block;
      background: #e9ecef;
      color: #333;
      padding: 2pt 8pt;
      border-radius: 4pt;
      font-size: 9pt;
      margin-right: 4pt;
      margin-bottom: 4pt;
    }
    .school-report table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      margin-bottom: 10pt;
      font-size: 10pt;
    }
    .school-report table td {
      padding: 4pt 8pt;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;
    }
    .school-report table td:first-child { font-weight: 600; width: 40%; }
    .school-report .visit-card {
      border: 1px solid #ddd;
      border-radius: 4pt;
      padding: 8pt 10pt;
      margin-bottom: 8pt;
      font-size: 10pt;
    }
    .school-report .visit-date { font-weight: 600; color: #1C2B4A; }
    .school-report .visit-staff { color: #666; font-size: 9pt; float: right; }
    .school-report .section-label {
      font-size: 11pt; font-weight: 600; color: #1C2B4A;
      margin: 10pt 0 6pt; border-bottom: 1px solid #e9ecef; padding-bottom: 3pt;
    }
    .school-report .no-data { color: #999; font-style: italic; font-size: 10pt; }
  }

  /* Screen styles */
  @media screen {
    #print-area { display: none; }
    #controls-bar {
      background: #fff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .print-instructions {
      color: #666; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .btn-print {
      background: #1C2B4A; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 0.6rem 2rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer; margin-top: 0.5rem;
    }
    .btn-print:hover { background: #2a3f6a; }
    .btn-print:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
    #preview-count {
      margin-top: 1rem; color: var(--epi-navy); font-weight: 600;
    }
  }
</style>

<div id="controls-bar">
  <h3 style="color:var(--epi-navy); margin-top:0;">Print School Profile Reports</h3>
  <p class="print-instructions">
    Select a date range to filter visit notes, then click <strong>Generate & Print</strong>.<br>
    Each school will appear on its own page. You can print to paper or save as PDF.
  </p>

  <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.75rem; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:1rem;">
    <label style="font-weight:600; color:var(--epi-navy); font-size:0.9rem;">Date Range:</label>
    <input type="date" id="print-date-start" value="', date_min, '" style="border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; padding:0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size:0.85rem;">
    <span style="color:#999;">to</span>
    <input type="date" id="print-date-end" value="', date_max, '" style="border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; padding:0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size:0.85rem;">
  </div>

  <button class="btn-print" id="btn-generate" onclick="generateAndPrint()">Generate & Print</button>
  <div id="preview-count"></div>
</div>

<div id="print-area"></div>

<script>
var ALL_SCHOOLS = ', data_json, ';

function inRange(dateStr, start, end) {
  if (!dateStr) return false;
  var d = dateStr.slice(0, 10);
  return d >= start && d <= end;
}

var PROGRAM_MAP = {
  "MGR": "MGR / Lanterns",
  "Non-Generating MGR": "Non-Generating MGR",
  "Library": "Library",
  "Computer": "Computers",
  "Feminine Hygiene Kits": "Menstrual Kits",
  "Science Kits": "Science Kits",
  "Construction Projects": "Construction",
  "Boreholes": "Boreholes",
  "Solar Power": "Solar Power",
  "Biofill Toilets": "Biofill Toilets",
  "Light a Village": "Light a Village"
};

function buildSchoolReport(slug, data, start, end) {
  var info = data.info;

  // Filter visits
  var allVisits = data.visits || [];
  var visits = allVisits;
  if (start && end && Array.isArray(allVisits)) {
    visits = allVisits.filter(function(v) {
      return inRange(v.visit_date || v.StartDate || "", start, end);
    });
  }

  var html = \'<div class="school-report">\';

  // School name
  html += "<h2>" + info.school_name + "</h2>";

  // Meta line
  var meta = [];
  if (info.Region) meta.push(info.Region + " Region");
  if (info["EPI Start Year"]) meta.push("EPI Partner Since " + info["EPI Start Year"]);
  meta.push("Report: " + start + " to " + end);
  html += \'<div class="meta">\' + meta.join(" &middot; ") + "</div>";

  // Programs
  var progs = Object.keys(PROGRAM_MAP)
    .filter(function(k) { return info[k] == 1; })
    .map(function(k) { return \'<span class="badge-print">\' + PROGRAM_MAP[k] + "</span>"; });
  if (progs.length > 0) {
    html += \'<div class="programs-list">\' + progs.join(" ") + "</div>";
  }

  // School Details from full update
  var fu = data.full_update;
  var latest = (Array.isArray(fu) && fu.length > 0) ? fu[fu.length - 1] : null;
  if (latest) {
    html += \'<div class="section-label">School Details</div>\';
    html += "<table>";
    if (latest.Q5) html += "<tr><td>Est. Community Population</td><td>" + parseInt(latest.Q5).toLocaleString() + "</td></tr>";
    if (latest.Q6) html += "<tr><td>Students Enrolled</td><td>" + parseInt(latest.Q6).toLocaleString() + "</td></tr>";
    if (latest.Q7) html += "<tr><td>Teachers</td><td>" + latest.Q7 + "</td></tr>";
    var primaryN = latest.Q8 ? parseInt(latest.Q8) : 0;
    var jhsN = (latest.Q10 === "Yes" && latest.Q11) ? parseInt(latest.Q11) : 0;
    if (primaryN > 0) html += "<tr><td>Primary Students</td><td>" + primaryN.toLocaleString() + "</td></tr>";
    if (jhsN > 0) html += "<tr><td>JHS Students</td><td>" + jhsN.toLocaleString() + "</td></tr>";
    if (latest.Q9) html += "<tr><td>Completed Primary to JHS</td><td>" + latest.Q9 + "</td></tr>";
    if (latest.Q12) html += "<tr><td>BECE Test Takers</td><td>" + latest.Q12 + "</td></tr>";
    if (latest.Q13) html += "<tr><td>BECE Passers</td><td>" + latest.Q13 + "</td></tr>";
    if (latest.Q15 && latest.Q15 !== "N/A") html += "<tr><td>Went to Secondary/Technical</td><td>" + latest.Q15 + "</td></tr>";
    html += "</table>";
  }

  // Visit Notes
  html += \'<div class="section-label">Visit Notes (\' + visits.length + " visit" + (visits.length !== 1 ? "s" : "") + ")</div>";
  if (visits.length > 0) {
    // Show visits newest first
    var sorted = visits.slice().sort(function(a, b) {
      return (b.visit_date || "").localeCompare(a.visit_date || "");
    });
    sorted.forEach(function(v) {
      html += \'<div class="visit-card">\';
      if (v.visitor) html += \'<span class="visit-staff">Staff: \' + v.visitor + "</span>";
      if (v.visit_date) html += \'<span class="visit-date">\' + v.visit_date + "</span>";
      html += "<br>";
      if (v.visit_reason) html += "<strong>Reason:</strong> " + v.visit_reason + "<br>";
      if (v.activities) html += "<strong>Activities:</strong> " + v.activities + "<br>";
      if (v.doing_well) html += "<strong>Doing well:</strong> " + v.doing_well + "<br>";
      if (v.struggles) html += "<strong>Struggles:</strong> " + v.struggles + "<br>";
      if (v.urgent_issues && v.urgent_issues.toLowerCase() !== "no" && v.urgent_issues.toLowerCase() !== "none" && v.urgent_issues.toLowerCase() !== "n/a") {
        html += \'<strong style="color:#dc3545;">Urgent Issues:</strong> \' + v.urgent_issues + "<br>";
      }
      if (v.observations) html += "<strong>Observations:</strong> " + v.observations + "<br>";
      html += "</div>";
    });
  } else {
    html += \'<p class="no-data">No visits recorded in this date range.</p>\';
  }

  html += "</div>";
  return html;
}

function generateAndPrint() {
  var start = document.getElementById("print-date-start").value;
  var end = document.getElementById("print-date-end").value;
  var btn = document.getElementById("btn-generate");
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = "Generating...";

  // Small delay so UI updates
  setTimeout(function() {
    var slugs = Object.keys(ALL_SCHOOLS).sort();
    var allHtml = "";
    var count = 0;

    slugs.forEach(function(slug) {
      allHtml += buildSchoolReport(slug, ALL_SCHOOLS[slug], start, end);
      count++;
    });

    document.getElementById("print-area").innerHTML = allHtml;
    document.getElementById("preview-count").textContent = count + " school reports generated.";

    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = "Generate & Print";

    // Trigger print
    setTimeout(function() { window.print(); }, 300);
  }, 100);
}
</script>
'))
```
